note: Round 7 of the Breakdown segmenters (#1241): a fresh real-text sample of 60 (seed 2026102607, rounds 5 and 6's frame) as the headline, a fresh adversarial batch of 10 apart, then the tuning set (round 6's held-out promoted) and the morphemes sets. jev-1.13.0 at 249b52282, 3 repetitions, the lab's cached jev transport, no reasoning model, no prompt change during the measurement runs. Strict is contractPass; lenient adds the confirmed noun-or-verb tolerance for a compound's first part. The headline leaves out the three rows the judges split on (contested). Both judges' calls were made in the round's own session, one from the system's point of view and one from the learner's, with no subagent.
fixes: The ge- affix test is one comparative choice: the cut, each option naming the word it leaves by its headwords (the letters as they stand, a noun's with its -e dropped or restored, each with the umlaut undone), against no cut (08a6c8a88)
The cut stays only when its best candidate outweighs no cut; the spellings are not summed (b3fba6253, after the prep live check)

The sense check weighs the splits against each other: round 6's yes or no per contender gives how far a split gives the sense at all (none as one minus the best yes), and a choice over the splits shares that yes; a pick no longer stands on its own yes (08a6c8a88 as a choice alone, 39b4b048c in its final form after the first tuning run)

Ground none in the dictionary: when the affix or word-formation test confirms a split (Gewässer's ge- 0.83), let it stand for the split's yes; and test a suffix derivation against the dictionary's analysis, not only its sense

proposedFixes.fix: A compound's head must pass the word test, as a cranberry first part's must
Before -ig and -lich, drop the ADJ route when the adjective test says no (round 6's fix 3)

The form question offers only headwords: drop an umlauted or -e form when its plain form is the noun (Wölke, Laste, Rene)

verdict: Not yet. On the 57 uncontested real-text cases the segmenters are 87.1% exact strict and lenient (149 of 171 attempts; 78% to 95% by a case bootstrap), against round 6's 92.1% on 55 cases (85% to 98%): the intervals overlap, so neither a gain nor a loss is shown, and this sample holds more derivations (11 against 7), where most misses fall. Both fixes work on what they target: the comparative affix test decided every ge- word of the adversarial batch right and fixed Geschichte and Gemüt, and the relative sense check fixed Verneigung and Musikerleben 🎧. The misses that remain are systematic, not rare-word noise: the sense check choosing a prefix + noun bracketing over prefix + verb (erzählen, and verfilmen in tuning), none winning on a low sense yes for a true derivation (sonderbar, Gewässer), a head that is no word (Ministerium), and suffix-base routes (ruhig, Wirtschafterin). Tuning should go on with fixes 1 to 5.
